ei.title: Materiality of Fashion as Cultural Heritage
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: When thinking of fashion as clothing and accessories, it is hard not to see it as an item, an object we purchase and use, and an object that, inevitably, is made of something — for one cannot think of fashion items without thinking of their materiality. Nevertheless, such materiality is inconceivable if not as a performance. Fashion is fabric, sartorial design, and the set of inventions and innovations that punctuate its history — none of these are static. The study of fabrics and pattern designs runs parallel to and complements the very study of our cultures and traditions. It is a matter, somewhat poetically, of dressing history, of giving it colors and design. The fabrics in which fashion items are made populate our cultural heritage: they remind us of traditions and rituals. They are even at times signs of economic change — nylon after the Second World War, sustainable fabrics nowadays. In many ways, the study of the material counterpart of fashion becomes a study of collective identity, of global trends, of the growth and evolution of societies — from the past to the present to the future.

det.korean: ①inevitably(필연적으로) ②scientific(과학적인←sartorial 재봉/패션의) ③populate(채우다) ④global(세계적인)

③ populate: 원단이 문화유산을 채운다 → 적절
④ global: 전 세계적 트렌드 → 적절
det.tip: sartorial(재봉의, 패션의) ↔ scientific(과학적인) — 맥락 부적합

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①inconceivable(상상할 수 없는) ②parallel(평행한) ③heritage(문화유산) ④decline(쇠퇴←evolution 발전/진화)
det.analysis:
① inconceivable: 물질성은 퍼포먼스 없이는 상상할 수 없다 → 적절
② parallel: 원단 연구는 문화 연구와 평행하게 진행된다 → 적절
③ heritage: 원단이 문화유산을 채운다 → 적절
④ decline: the growth and decline of societies → 글의 맥락은 사회의 성장과 발전(evolution)인데 '쇠퇴(decline)'는 이와 반대 방향이므로 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: evolution(발전/진화) ↔ decline(쇠퇴) — 사회 성장 맥락에 모순

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

① 패션 물질성 연구는 문화적 전통 연구와 별개 → 원문: runs parallel to and complements the very study of our cultures → 별개가 아니라 보완 관계, 불일치 ←정답

det.tip: runs parallel to and complements = 병행하며 보완 (별개가 아님)

나일론은 제2차 세계대전 이후 경제 변화의 신호로 제시된다.
패션 물질성은 패션 아이템의 소재에 대한 생각과 분리될 수 없다.

questions.passage: When thinking of fashion as clothing and accessories, it is hard not to see it as an item, an object we purchase and use, and an object that, inevitably, is made of something — for one cannot think of fashion items without thinking of their materiality. Nevertheless, such materiality is inconceivable if not as a performance. Fashion is fabric, sartorial design, and the set of inventions and innovations that punctuate its history — none of these are static. The study of fabrics and pattern designs runs parallel to and complements the very study of our cultures and traditions. It is a matter, somewhat poetically, of dressing history, of giving it colors and design. The fabrics in which fashion items are made populate our cultural heritage: they remind us of traditions and rituals. They are even at times signs of economic change — nylon after the Second World War, sustainable fabrics nowadays. In many ways, the study of the material counterpart of fashion becomes a study of collective identity, of global trends, of the growth and evolution of societies — from the past to the present to the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④원단이 문화유산을 채운다 → 일치
det.analysis:
① 퍼포먼스 없이도 상상 가능 → 원문: inconceivable if not as a performance → 불일치
② 변하지 않는다 → 원문: none of these are static (정적이지 않다) → 불일치
③ 과거에 한정 → 원문: from the past to the present to the future → 불일치
④ fabrics populate our cultural heritage → 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: populate our cultural heritage = 문화유산을 채운다

ch: 패션 물질성은 퍼포먼스 없이도 상상 가능하다.
